comment: The one place the toolchain versions live. Nix, the webOS and Android
cross builds, the Windows scripts and the Actions workflows all read
these fields rather than repeating a version string of their own.
libplacebo needs a GLSL compiler for both its Vulkan and D3D11 backends,
and SPIRV-Cross to reach HLSL for the latter. Linux gets both from nixpkgs;
Windows has neither, and Meson's WrapDB carries no glslang or shaderc, so
they are built from source there the way FFmpeg already is. Vulkan headers
are not among them: libplacebo carries its own under 3rdparty.
